# Security
{: .no_toc }

Password, two-factor and active sessions in one place.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `ACC-04` |
| **Route** | `/account/security` · deep link `substratal://account/security` |
| **Where** | Personal › Account |
| **Who can use it** | Self |
| **Kind** | settings |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwPreferencesPage` |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Password | row → ACC-03 |  | "Change…" | AdwActionRow activatable |
| Two-factor authentication | toggle | User.mfa_enabled | on → ACC-05; off → ACC-06 | AdwSwitchRow |
| Sessions | list | Session[]: user_agent → device name/icon, ip_address → approximate location*, last_seen_at, current | current session marked "This device" and not revocable here | GtkListBox .boxed-list |
| Sign out | row-button | DELETE /users/me/sessions/{sessionId} | per non-current row | suffix GtkButton .flat |
| Sign out of all other sessions | destructive-button | POST /users/me/sessions/revoke-all {keep_current: true} | confirm first; also stops push to those sessions' devices | GtkButton .destructive-action |
| Devices & notifications | row → NTF-03 | count of active devices |  | AdwActionRow activatable |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Revoke one | `DELETE /users/me/sessions/{sessionId}` | Optimistic remove; 404 → already gone, refresh. |
| Sign out everywhere else | `POST /users/me/sessions/revoke-all {keep_current: true}` | Confirm first (COPY). `keep_current` keeps this device signed in (`logout all_sessions` would sign it out too). 200 `{revoked}` → toast "Signed out of {n} other sessions", refresh the list. Revoking a session deactivates the push devices it registered. |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES
- *IP → city lookup is client-side/optional; never show the raw IP to non-staff unless the user expands details.

## For developers

Loads: `GET /users/me` · `GET /users/me/sessions`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
